title: Page 8
content_zh:
周遭看戏的老百姓等太久，耐不住性子的嚷叫了。
郑凯却似无感，直勾勾的看着夏羽柔，她好像变得更美了，他有些看痴了。
其实他是喜欢她的，两人也算青梅竹马，在他动不动就生病的岁月里，她是他眼中最美的风景，她拿了东西给他吃，拿一些新奇玩意儿给他玩……
随着家境好转，母亲却不喜她了，尤其在他中了秀才后，就想换媳妇儿。
后来，夏大伯来逼娶让爹娘更加不喜，对她弟弟忽视怠慢，毁了两人的洞房花烛夜，再也没机会在一起。后来母亲的怒骂，她的疏离，让他怒不可遏，再来是休妻另娶，本以为此生无缘，母亲却改了心意。
「总是被休的女子，不好说婆家，再说了，一女不事二夫，再回头当你的女人，外人也不会多说什么，夏羽柔更会心存感激，你还愿意要她。」
母亲的话，他没有多想，妻子柳氏也点头，他太高兴了，他也知道夏羽柔现在的状况，她有赚钱的酒楼，他可以人财两得。
他带着这样的念想与欢喜，带着母亲一起来找她，她却字字戳心。
孙氏拉了拉儿子的袖子，「跟她说些话啊。」孙氏这两年多过得不顺遂，整个人看起来更老一些，也添了刻薄颜色。
郑凯被母亲一提醒，含情脉脉的看着夏羽柔道：「阿柔，我是真心的，你回到我身边，我一定会好好待你……」
「抱歉，对回到你身边我一点兴趣也没有，还有，你读着圣贤书就该说人话，别忘了，你我早恩断义绝，什么狗屁真心，你有这种东西吗？」
旁观老百姓居然默契一致的大喊，「没有。」
没办法，夏家与郑家的事，连三岁小儿都听说过。
孙氏脸色难看，郑凯更是恼羞成怒，尤其夏羽柔一脸的不屑更是激怒他，他厉声道：「夏羽柔，我这是给你脸——」
夏羽柔哼声道：「我不要脸不行吗？」
老百姓们又是哈哈大笑，大喊，「可以。」
「谢谢！谢谢乡亲父老们的支持。」夏羽柔笑咪咪的朝大家拱手。
郑凯恨恨的道：「你一定会后悔的，你是下堂妇……」
「我有什么好后悔？是，我后悔我当年的年少无知；后悔我爹娘对我的心软疼宠，应了你的亲事；更后悔我娘将你视为半子，天天炖补药给你喝，我爹更是花更多心力为你上课，你现在的成就跟好的身体，我们夏家不是没有功劳，但你们郑家没有人感念，对我跟弟弟不曾关心，冷漠无情的令人心寒。」
她的指责没有丝毫夸大，只要镇里有点年纪的人都知道当年那些事，看孙氏母子的脸色就充满鄙视。

孙氏却忍不住驳斥，「那时嫁进我家，你可是目无尊长，不事夫君，巧舌如簧，不知礼数！」
「是，只要没有任你们郑家人搓圆捏扁，我便是不孝，便是不知天高地厚，可笑的是，那些规矩只有我这外姓人要遵从。」夏羽柔嗤之以鼻。
郑凯知道孙氏对夏羽柔的种种挑剔，但他毕竟是男儿，又要科考，自是以读书为重，婆媳间那些细枝末节的琐事，他是不管也不想听。何况，与她相处时日愈久，愈明白她不是个任人欺负的柔弱女子，他更是没想过她会委屈，需要有人支持。
「不会的，母亲她会改的，我也会护着你的，阿柔。」郑凯说。
夏羽柔依然语气冷漠，「抱歉，你再改也没用，我对你还真的一点兴趣都没有。」
郑凯有点受伤，他自诩生得不错，却不知这段时日一半沉溺女色，一半生活不顺遂，让他整个人身上都带着郁气，硬是让那张曾经俊秀的脸显得浮肿。
此时，夏羽柔的眼角余光看到汤某人也往这里挤过来了。
「还有，我身边如今有个大美男在关注我，与你相较，你是长得比较伤眼睛。」
她很故意的指指汤绍玄的方向，于是众人都顺着她指的方向看过去，然后一致的喊——
「汤爷。」
又有人接着说：「伤眼睛还说得太客气了，跟汤爷比，郑举人这叫丑。」
郑凯身形单薄，面色略黄，那双本该好看的凤眸多了算计，少了清明，再看看汤绍玄，高俊挺拔，一袭玄色袍服更衬得他俊逸不凡，甫一现身就有好多姑娘、媳妇儿将眼睛黏到他身上。
郑凯的自信也被打碎，与汤绍玄一比，他彻底明白何为云泥之别。
汤绍玄全身散发着慑人的冷漠气质，眼神再一扫——那幽深眼眸如泛着寒光的利刃，能震慑他的灵魂。
由于汤绍玄登场，孙氏、郑凯的勇气全消，很快的走人。
第十四章 两情相悦迎接新婚(1)
人潮不散，原因就在汤绍玄，世人爱八卦嘛。
所以夏羽柔很有魄力的直接拉着他进入酒楼，再到小院，才一脸抱歉的对着他道：「拿汤爷来当挡箭牌，只是为应付郑人渣，希望你别生气。」
汤绍玄沉默的看着她。
四目相对，她就觉心虚，明知他心悦范梓璃，她却当众说那些话，也难怪他不满。

「我去忙了！」她转身就走，他却一把扣住她的手腕拉住她，她忐忑不安的看着他，「汤爷还有事吩咐？」
「我有事跟你说。」他神情严肃。
是要跟她算帐？怪她不该拿他当挡箭牌？还是要提醒自己，他有心上人，要她不要有任何妄想？不管是哪一个，她都不想听……
她难过伤心，她只想去找棵大树，把自己完完全全藏起来。
夏羽柔咬咬下唇，干笑一声，「那个——我很清楚你的感情，我不会去破坏……」
「我是心悦于你。」
她摇摇头，「没关系，我知道你爱的是……」她震惊的抬头，「等等，你你你说什么？」
汤绍玄深深的看着她，「我说我心悦于你。」
幸福来得太快，夏羽柔有点晕眩，就算汤绍玄带她上马车一路回到他住的山中别院，她还是觉得踩在云海上，没有半分踏实感。
但她记得他说：「我有很重要的事要跟你说。」
夏羽柔坐在榻上，喝了杯茶，理智回笼了些，眼睛更清亮，但莫名的，她觉得氛围有些沉重，他坐在案桌前，喝了一杯茶，看着她时，黑眸中有难以言喻的复杂情绪，有怒、有苦、有痛、有遗憾——闲杂人等都退出了屋子，唯有几名暗卫暗中守护，她静静的陪坐一旁，良久，听见他低哑着声音说起有关他的一切。
「后宫原就暗潮汹涌，一日，皇后一派被陷害有谋反夺位之心，皇后娘家，也就是镇国公府全府遭罪，一夕间血流成河，仅有我与妹妹在外，没赶得及与家人共赴黄泉，但也避不开被捕的命运……」
她难掩错愕，「所以……」
「我被打入死牢，姑母——皇后暗中安排，拿一名死囚与我交换，代替我被押赴刑场，而我再与一名姑母安排的衙役换装，成功逃离牢狱，接着成为一名押送流放犯人的官差，一路护送被流放的妹妹，一行十名衙差里，两名是知我身分的人，但其他的不是。」
他顿了一下，又道：「原本姑母已经提前买通押送的官差，但与姑母不和的容妃使了计，塞人进来想要解决我妹妹，她跟姑母从当姑娘时就一路竞争，进了宫也在争宠，对姑母怨恨极深，镇国公府毁灭，她仍觉得不够，她要将我妹妹除掉，让姑母痛苦自责。」
「你这一路跟妹妹流放一定很辛苦。」听到这里，她已经知道范梓璃的身分了。
content_en:
The people watching the theater around had been waiting for too long and couldn't bear to shout.
Zheng Kai seemed indifferent and looked straight at Xia Yurou. She seemed to have become more beautiful. He was a little obsessed.
In fact, he liked her, and they were childhood sweethearts. During the years when he was often sick, she was the most beautiful scenery in his eyes. She brought him things to eat, and gave him some novelties to play with...
As her family's situation improved, her mother no longer liked her, especially after he became a scholar, and wanted to change his wife.
Later, Uncle Xia came to force her to marry her, which made her parents even more unhappy. He neglected and neglected her younger brother, ruining their wedding night and giving them no chance to be together again. Later, his mother's scolding and her alienation made him furious. Then he divorced his wife and married another woman. He thought he would never have a chance to marry her again, but his mother changed her mind.
"It's hard to talk about a woman who is divorced from her husband's family. Besides, one woman does not matter to two husbands. When she comes back to be your woman, outsiders won't say anything. Xia Yurou will be even more grateful, and you are still willing to have her."
He didn't think much about his mother's words, and his wife Liu Shi also nodded. He was so happy. He also knew Xia Yurou's current situation. She had a profitable restaurant, and he could get both people and money.
With such longing and joy, he brought his mother to find her, but she spoke every word that spoke to his heart.
Mrs. Sun pulled her son's sleeve and said, "Tell her something." Mrs. Sun's life has not been going well in the past two years. She looks older and more mean-spirited.
When Zheng Kai was reminded by his mother, he looked at Xia Yu Ju with affection and said: "A Rou, I am sincere. If you come back to me, I will treat you well..."
"I'm sorry, I'm not interested in returning to you at all. Also, you should speak human words while reading the book of sages. Don't forget, we have broken off our friendship long ago. What kind of bullshit is sincerity? Do you have such a thing?"
The people watching unexpectedly shouted in unison, "No."
There is no way, even a three-year-old child has heard about the Xia family and the Zheng family.
Sun's face was ugly, and Zheng Kai was even more angry. The disdain on Xia Yurou's face especially angered him. He said sternly: "Xia Yurou, I am giving you face-"
Xia Yurou snorted, "Can't I be shameless?"
The common people laughed again and shouted, "Okay."
"Thank you! Thank you fellow villagers for your support." Xia Yurou smiled and held her hands in front of everyone.
Zheng Kai said bitterly: "You will definitely regret it, you are a concubine..."
"What do I regret? Yes, I regret my youth and ignorance. I regret that my parents were so soft-hearted and doting on me and agreed to your marriage. I regret even more that my mother regarded you as her half-brother and stewed tonics for you to drink every day. My father put more effort into your lessons. Your current achievements and good health are not without credit to our Xia family, but no one in your Zheng family is grateful and has no concern for me and my brother. It is so cold and heartless."
Her accusations were not exaggerated in the slightest. Anyone of a certain age in the town knew what happened back then, and the faces of Sun and her son were full of contempt.
But Mrs. Sun couldn't help but refute, "When you married into my family, you were disrespectful, indifferent to your husband, silver-tongued, and ignorant of etiquette!"
"Yes, as long as I don't let you Zheng family round and flatten them, I am unfilial and ignorant. What's funny is that only a person with a foreign surname like me has to abide by those rules." Xia Yurou sneered.
Zheng Kai knew that Sun was picky about Xia Yurou, but he was a man after all, and he had to take the scientific examination, so studying was his priority. He didn't care about the trivial matters between mother-in-law and daughter-in-law, and he didn't want to hear about them. What's more, the longer he spent with her, the more he understood that she was not a weak woman who could be bullied, and he never thought that she would be wronged and need someone to support her.
"No, mother will change, and I will protect you, Ah Rou." Zheng Kai said.
Xia Yurou's tone was still cold, "I'm sorry, there's no point in changing it. I'm really not interested in you at all."None. "
Zheng Kai was a little hurt. He thought he was born well, but he didn't know that during this period, he was half addicted to women and half his life was not going smoothly, which made his whole body full of depression and made his once handsome face look swollen.
At this time, Xia Yurou saw someone from the corner of her eye, Tang, also squeezing in here.
"Also, there is a handsome man next to me now who is paying attention to me. Compared with you, you are more eye-catching."
She pointed in the direction of Tang Shaoxuan very deliberately, so everyone looked in the direction she pointed, and then shouted in unison -
"Master Tang."
Another person continued: "It hurts the eyes and that's too polite. Compared with Mr. Tang, Zheng Juren is called ugly."
Zheng Kai has a thin figure and a slightly yellow complexion. His phoenix eyes that should be beautiful are more calculated and less clear. Looking at Tang Shaoxuan, he is tall and tall. His black robe makes him even more handsome. As soon as he appears, many girls and wives fix their eyes on him.
Zheng Kai's self-confidence was also shattered. Compared with Tang Shaoxuan, he completely understood the difference between cloud and mud.
Tang Shaoxuan's whole body exuded an awe-inspiring indifferent temperament, and one glance at him - those deep eyes were like sharp blades glowing with cold light, which could shock his soul.
As Tang Shaoxuan appeared, Sun and Zheng Kai lost all their courage and left quickly.
Chapter 14: Two people happily welcome the wedding (1)
The reason why the crowd lingers is Tang Shaoxuan. People love gossip.
So Xia Yurou had the courage to drag him directly into the restaurant, then to the small courtyard, and then said to him with an apologetic look: "I'm using Mr. Tang as a shield just to deal with scumbag Zheng. I hope you won't be angry."
Tang Shaoxuan looked at her silently.
When their eyes met, she felt guilty. She knew that he liked Fan Zili, but she said those words in public. No wonder he was dissatisfied.
"I'm going to do my work!" She turned around and left, but he grabbed her wrist and pulled her back. She looked at him anxiously, "Master Tang, do you have anything else to say?"
"I have something to tell you." He looked serious.
Do you want to settle accounts with her? Is it her fault that she shouldn't use him as a shield? Or should he remind himself that he has a sweetheart and ask her not to have any delusions? No matter which one it is, she doesn't want to hear it...
She was sad and sad. She just wanted to find a big tree and hide herself completely.
Xia Yurou bit her lower lip and laughed dryly, "Well - I know your feelings very well and I won't destroy them..."
"My heart is pleased with you."
She shook her head, "It doesn't matter, I know what you love is..." She raised her head in shock, "Wait, what did you say?"
Tang Shaoxuan looked at her deeply, "I said that I am happy with you."
Happiness came so fast that Xia Yurou was a little dizzy. Even if Tang Shaoxuan took her in the carriage all the way back to the mountain courtyard where he lived, she still felt that she was stepping on a sea of clouds and did not feel at all at ease.
But she remembers him saying, "I have something very important to tell you."
Xia Yurou sat on the couch and drank a cup of tea. She regained her senses and her eyes were clearer, but for some reason, she felt that the atmosphere was a little heavy. He sat at the desk and drank a cup of tea. When he looked at her, there were indescribable complex emotions in his dark eyes, including anger, bitterness, pain, and regret. Everyone else had left the room, with only a few secret guards guarding her. She sat quietly beside him, and for a long time, she heard him talking about everything about him in a low voice.
"There was a turbulent undercurrent in the harem. One day, the queen's faction was framed for plotting to seize the throne. The queen's natal family, that is, the entire government of the Zhenguo Palace suffered, and blood flowed overnight. My sister and I were the only ones outside. We did not have time to go to hell with my family, but we could not avoid the fate of being arrested..."
She couldn't hide her surprise, "So..."
"I was sent to death row, and my aunt, the Queen, secretly arranged for me to be exchanged for a death row prisoner, and he was taken to the execution ground in my place. I then changed my clothes with a government servant arranged by my aunt, and successfully escaped from the prison, and then became an official escorting exiled prisoners.I escorted my exiled sister on the road. Among the ten government officials in the group, two were people who knew my identity, but the others were not. "
He paused and then said: "Originally, my aunt had paid off the escort officials in advance, but Concubine Rong, who was at odds with my aunt, came up with a trick. The Sai people came in and wanted to deal with my sister. She and her aunt have been competing with each other since they were girls, and they also competed for favor after entering the palace. She has a deep resentment towards my aunt, and the government palace was destroyed. She still feels that it is not enough. She wants to get rid of my sister and make my aunt suffer and blame herself."
"It must have been hard for you to live in exile with your sister." After hearing this, she already knew Fan Zili's identity.
